content: All Playwright tests must follow Page Object Model.
API tests must validate status code and response schema.
Selectors should use data-testid whenever possible.
Every pull request must include negative test scenarios.
Sensitive credentials should never be hardcoded in test scripts.
Failed tests must capture screenshots and logs.
API automation must validate error responses for invalid inputs.
Avoid fixed waits. Use explicit waits and locator-based synchronization.
Test data should be isolated and reusable across environments.
Reusable utilities must be placed inside shared framework components.
